message: Designed a premium AI Hackathon certificate featuring a navy and gold palette, Cinzel title typography, and a balanced layout for high-visibility recipient and rank data.

design_notes: Used 'Cinzel' for the title to convey a premium, authoritative feel.
The secondary color #eab308 (gold) is used as an accent for the certificate type and rank to provide contrast against the navy text.
Centered the metadata to maintain a clean vertical axis while placing the signature and QR code in the traditional footer corners.
